newsitem.title: ITALY: Venice under water for second Xmas this century.
newsitem.headline: Venice under water for second Xmas this century.

text.p: Venice spent Christmas under water for only the second time this century as heavy rains and high seas caused the lagoon city to flood.

Local authorities said water levels reached 1.11 metres (3 ft 7 in) above the normal tide level on Christmas Day and added that although conditions improved on Thursday, St Mark's Square remained flooded.
Venice last spent Christmas under water in 1973.
It was the ninth time this year that the waters in this northern Italian city had risen above the 1.1 metre (3 ft 7 in) level.
St Mark's Square, which is the lowest point in the city, has been flooded on 99 days so far this year.
